title: Moroccan Kiwifruit Chebakia
description: A sweet and tangy dessert fusion of traditional Moroccan chebakia with the freshness of kiwifruit.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and spices.
Roll out dough on a floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into diamond shapes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, puree kiwifruit in a blender or food processor.
Strain kiwifruit puree through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl.
Add honey to kiwifruit puree and mix well.
Drizzle kiwifruit glaze over warm chebakia.
